mapper.sql: SELECT cm.id AS cm_id, cm.model_id AS cm_model_id, cm.version_label, cm.status, cm.is_default, cm.normalization_method, cm.formula, cm.ref_version, cm.algo_version, tm.code AS tm_code, tm.name AS tm_name FROM apms_combo_model cm LEFT JOIN apms_test_model tm ON cm.model_id = tm.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_combo_model (model_id, version_label, status, is_default, normalization_method, formula, ref_version, algo_version) VALUES (#{modelId}, #{versionLabel}, #{status}, #{isDefault}, #{normalizationMethod}, #{formula}, #{refVersion}, #{algoVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_combo_model WHERE model_id = #{modelId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM apms_combo_model WHERE id IN #{id}
